ud2.8:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kuṇḍiyāyaṃ viharati kuṇḍiṭṭhānavane.
ud2.8:1.3: tena kho pana samayena suppavāsā koliyadhītā satta vassāni gabbhaṃ dhāreti
ud2.8:1.4: sattāhaṃ mūḷhagabbhā. sā dukkhāhi tippāhi kaṭukāhi vedanāhi phuṭṭhā tīhi vitakkehi adhivāseti
ud2.8:1.5: sammāsambuddho vata so bhagavā yo imassa evarūpassa dukkhassa pahānāya dhammaṃ deseti
ud2.8:1.6: supaṭipanno vata tassa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho yo imassa evarūpassa dukkhassa pahānāya paṭipanno
ud2.8:1.7: susukhaṃ vata nibbānaṃ yatthidaṃ evarūpaṃ dukkhaṃ na saṃvijjatīti.
ud2.8:2.1: atha kho suppavāsā koliyadhītā sāmikaṃ āmantesi

ud2.8:2.3: suppavāsā bhante koliyadhītā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatīti
ud2.8:2.5: suppavāsā bhante koliyadhītā satta vassāni gabbhaṃ dhāreti

ud2.8:2.7: sammāsambuddho vata so bhagavā yo imassa evarūpassa dukkhassa pahānāya dhammaṃ deseti

ud2.8:3.9: susukhaṃ vata nibbānaṃ yatthidaṃ evarūpaṃ dukkhaṃ na saṃvijjatīti.
ud2.8:4.1: sukhinī hotu suppavāsā koliyadhītā arogā arogaṃ puttaṃ vijāyatūti.
ud2.8:4.2: saha vacanā ca pana bhagavato suppavāsā koliyadhītā sukhinī arogā arogaṃ puttaṃ vijāyi.
ud2.8:5.1: evaṃ bhanteti kho so koliyaputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena sakaṃ gharaṃ tena paccayāsi.
ud2.8:5.2: addasā kho so koliyaputto suppavāsaṃ koliyadhītaraṃ sukhiniṃ arogaṃ arogaṃ puttaṃ vijātaṃ
ud2.8:5.4: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhūtaṃ vata bho tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā yatra hi nāmāyaṃ suppavāsā koliyadhītā saha vacanā ca pana bhagavato sukhinī arogā arogaṃ puttaṃ vijāyissatīti
ud2.8:6.1: atha kho suppavāsā koliyadhītā sāmikaṃ āmantesi
ud2.8:6.2: ehi tvaṃ ayyaputta yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato sirasā vandāhi
ud2.8:6.3: suppavāsā bhante koliyadhītā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatīti
ud2.8:6.5: suppavāsā bhante koliyadhītā satta vassāni gabbhaṃ dhāreti
ud2.8:6.6: sattāhaṃ mūḷhagabbhā sā etarahi sukhinī arogā arogaṃ puttaṃ vijātā
ud2.8:6.7: sā sattāhaṃ buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ bhattena nimanteti
ud2.8:6.8: adhivāsetu kira bhante bhagavā suppavāsāya koliyadhītāya satta bhattāni saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.

ud2.8:8.1: suppavāsā bhante koliyadhītā bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati
ud2.8:8.3: suppavāsā bhante koliyadhītā satta vassāni gabbhaṃ dhāresi
ud2.8:8.4: sattāhaṃ mūḷhagabbhā sā etarahi sukhinī arogā arogaṃ puttaṃ vijātā
ud2.8:8.5: sā sattāhaṃ buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ bhattena nimanteti
ud2.8:8.6: adhivāsetu kira bhante bhagavā suppavāsāya koliyadhītāya satta bhattāni saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
ud2.8:9.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena upāsakena buddhappamukho bhikkhusaṅgho svātanāya bhattena nimantito hoti.
ud2.8:9.2: so ca upāsako āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa upaṭṭhāko hoti.
ud2.8:9.3: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ āmantesi
ud2.8:9.4: ehi tvaṃ moggallāna yena so upāsako tenupasaṅkama upasaṅkamitvā taṃ upāsakaṃ evaṃ vadehi
ud2.8:9.5: suppavāsā āvuso koliyadhītā satta vassāni gabbhaṃ dhāresi
ud2.8:9.6: sattāhaṃ mūḷhagabbhā sā etarahi sukhinī arogā arogaṃ puttaṃ vijātā
ud2.8:9.7: sā sattāhaṃ buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ bhattena nimanteti
ud2.8:9.8: karotu suppavāsā koliyadhītā satta bhattāni pacchā so karissati tuyhaṃ
ud2.8:10.1: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavato paṭissutvā yena so upāsako tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ upāsakaṃ etadavoca
ud2.8:10.2: suppavāsā āvuso koliyadhītā satta vassāni gabbhaṃ dhāresi
ud2.8:10.3: sattāhaṃ mūḷhagabbhā. sā etarahi sukhinī arogā arogaṃ puttaṃ vijātā
ud2.8:10.4: sā sattāhaṃ buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ bhattena nimanteti
ud2.8:10.5: karotu suppavāsā koliyadhītā satta bhattāni pacchā tvaṃ karissasīti.
ud2.8:11.1: sace me bhante ayyo mahāmoggallāno tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pāṭibhogo
ud2.8:11.3: karotu suppavāsā koliyadhītā satta bhattāni pacchā karissāmīti.
ud2.8:11.4: dvinnaṃ kho te ahaṃ āvuso dhammānaṃ pāṭibhogo
ud2.8:12.1: sace bhante ayyo mahāmoggallāno dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ pāṭibhogo
ud2.8:12.3: karotu suppavāsā koliyadhītā satta bhattāni pacchā karissāmīti.
ud2.8:13.1: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ upāsakaṃ saññāpetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
ud2.8:13.3: karotu suppavāsā koliyadhītā satta bhattāni pacchā so karissatīti.
ud2.8:14.1: atha kho suppavāsā koliyadhītā sattāhaṃ buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi
ud2.8:15.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto taṃ dārakaṃ etadavoca
ud2.8:15.2: kacci vo dāraka khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci na kiñci dukkhanti.
ud2.8:15.3: kuto me bhante sāriputta khamanīyaṃ kuto yāpanīyaṃ
ud2.8:16.2: putto me dhammasenāpatinā saddhiṃ mantetīti attamanā pamuditā pītisomanassajātā ahosi.
ud2.8:16.3: atha kho bhagavā suppavāsaṃ koliyadhītaraṃ attamanaṃ pamuditaṃ pītisomanassajātaṃ viditvā suppavāsaṃ koliyadhītaraṃ etadavoca
ud2.8:16.4: iccheyyāsi tvaṃ suppavāse aññampi evarūpaṃ puttanti.
ud2.8:16.5: iccheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavā aññānipi evarūpāni satta puttānīti.
ud2.8:17.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
